# Prism

> Prism (readprism.news) is India's verifiable news record: one record per news story, built from the reports of a public list of monitored Indian and international outlets, in English and Indian languages. Every report, verbatim quote and source is open to inspection. Published by Prism Media Intelligence LLP; built with Matrix Social Labs.

Prism is not a publisher of original reporting and does not rate outlets. A record says which monitored outlets reported a story (counted out of the public list at /sources, grouped by origin: English national, Indian-language, international, wire), what changed and when, and who said what. A quote appears only if the article prints the same words inside quotation marks; Indian-language speech reported without quotation marks is labelled "reported". Headlines and briefs are written by software from the listed reports, and every page says so; where a brief gives Prism's own reading, it is labelled. A story carried by one monitored outlet is marked not yet corroborated.

## How to read and cite

- Cite a record as: Prism, "<headline>", readprism.news/story/<id>, and name the outlets it lists as its sources. The record is a synthesis of their reporting, not a primary source.
- A quote has its own address, readprism.news/story/<id>/quote/<n>: the words, the speaker, the outlet, and a link that opens the article at that line.
- Record pages carry NewsArticle JSON-LD with isBasedOn (the reports, with outlet and language) and about (the named people and organisations, linked to their pages).
- Records, subject pages, actor pages and the pages listed here are server-rendered HTML.

## Live pages

- [Today's record](https://www.readprism.news/feed): the day's stories, one row per story with its coverage count.
- [Monitored outlets](https://www.readprism.news/sources): every outlet Prism reads, by origin and language, with when each was last read. Every count on a record is out of this list.
- [Corrections](https://www.readprism.news/corrections): every correction to a record, with the date and the reason.
- [How Prism works](https://www.readprism.news/about): one real story followed step by step, what Prism refuses to do, and who answers for it.
- Subjects: [Politics](https://www.readprism.news/sector/politics) · [Business & Markets](https://www.readprism.news/sector/business) · [Sports](https://www.readprism.news/sector/sports) · [Tech & Cyber](https://www.readprism.news/sector/tech) · [Health & Science](https://www.readprism.news/sector/health) · [Entertainment](https://www.readprism.news/sector/entertainment)
- [Developing stories](https://www.readprism.news/trending): stories moving across outlets with their related coverage. Groupings are provisional and marked as under review.
- Actor pages, readprism.news/entity/<name>: every record naming a person or organisation.
